# 2.4 On Model Selection w/ Corrected Traits 
## Packages

```{r}
rm(list = ls()) ## Empty environment
gc()

require(vegan)          # Ecological analysis
library(readxl)         # Read Excel files
library(reshape2)       # Data reshaping
library(SYNCSA)         # SYNCSA for trait-environment modeling
library(openxlsx)       # Exporting Excel
library(tidyverse)      # Data manipulation and visualization
library(foreach)        # Parallel processing (loop)
library(doParallel)     # Parallel backend
library(bbmle)          # AICc model selection
source("func/summarize_trees.R")  # Custom summarizing function 


# This function summarizes model selection results across N scenarios.
get_result <- function(sel_md) {
  # For each scenario, extract the best model (delta AICc = 0)
  result_1 <- foreach(i = 1:N) %do%
    {
      cbind.data.frame(
        models = rownames(sel_md[[i]]),
        sel_md[[i]],
        row.names = NULL
      ) %>%
        filter(dAICc == 0)
    } %>%
    plyr::ldply(.fun = data.frame)

  # Summarize the performance of each model across scenarios
  summary <- cbind.data.frame(
    n_sel = tapply(result_1$dAICc, result_1$models, length),          # Times selected as best
    AICc_mean = tapply(result_1$AICc, result_1$models, mean),         # Mean AICc
    AICc_min = round(tapply(result_1$AICc, result_1$models, min), 2), # Min AICc
    AICc_max = round(tapply(result_1$AICc, result_1$models, max), 2), # Max AICc
    dAICc_mean = tapply(result_1$dAICc, result_1$models, mean),       # Mean delta AICc
    dAICc_min = round(tapply(result_1$dAICc, result_1$models, min), 2), # Min delta AICc
    dAICc_max = round(tapply(result_1$dAICc, result_1$models, min), 2), # Max delta AICc
    df = tapply(result_1$df, result_1$models, mean)                   # Degrees of freedom
  )
  return(summary)
}

set.seed(811)          # Ensure reproducibility
options(scipen = 999)  # Disable scientific notation
N = 1000               # Number of iterations (e.g., phylogenetic trees)
```
## Trait Matrix

```{r}
#Load data base
S_comp <- readRDS("outputs/RDS/SCOMP.RDS")
org_data <- readRDS("data/org_data.RDS")
```
## Do Parallel Computing

```{r}
no_cores <- detectCores() - 4     # Reserve some CPU cores for system (adjust as needed)
registerDoParallel(cores = no_cores)
cl <- makeCluster(no_cores, type = "FORK")  # Linux/Mac only
```
## Fitting models with traits CWM
### Rhizome diameter

```{r}
# Loop over all N iterations (e.g., permutations or bootstrap samples), organizing data for analysis
or_s_diam <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar% {
  organize.syncsa(
    org_data$community,                  # community matrix
    envir = org_data$environmental,      # environmental variables
    traits = data.frame(diam = S_comp$riz_diam[[i]]) # trait: rhizome diameter
  )
}

# Compute community-weighted means (CWM) for rhizome diameter in each dataset
cwm_S_r_diam <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar% {
  (matrix.t(
    or_s_diam[[i]]$community,            # community matrix
    or_s_diam[[i]]$traits,               # trait matrix (rhizome diameter)
    scale = F                            # do not scale
  )$matrix.T)                            # extract T matrix (CWM result)
}

# Define candidate linear models (as formulas) to explain rhizome diameter using different predictors
models <- c(
  "Rhiz. Diam ~ MT + plot_size + samp_size",
  "Rhiz. Diam ~ MT + AP + plot_size + samp_size",
  "Rhiz. Diam ~ AP * PS + plot_size + samp_size",
  "Rhiz. Diam ~ N + plot_size + samp_size",
  "DIAM ~ CEC + plot_size + samp_size",
  "Rhiz. Diam ~ N + CEC + plot_size + samp_size",
  "Rhiz. Diam ~ 1" # original model
)


# Fit all candidate models using parallel processing
md1 <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(
    cwm_S_r_diam[[i]] ~ max_temp_wam + plot_size + samp_size,
    data = or_s_diam[[i]]$environmental
  )

md2 <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(
    cwm_S_r_diam[[i]] ~
      max_temp_wam +
        ann_prec +
        plot_size +
        samp_size,
    data = or_s_diam[[i]]$environmental
  )

md3 <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(
    cwm_S_r_diam[[i]] ~
      ann_prec *
        prec_seas +
        plot_size +
        samp_size,
    data = or_s_diam[[i]]$environmental
  )

md4 <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(
    cwm_S_r_diam[[i]] ~ nitrogen + plot_size + samp_size,
    data = or_s_diam[[i]]$environmental
  )

md5 <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(
    cwm_S_r_diam[[i]] ~ cec + plot_size + samp_size,
    data = or_s_diam[[i]]$environmental
  )

md6 <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(
    cwm_S_r_diam[[i]] ~
      nitrogen +
        cec +
        plot_size +
        samp_size,
    data = or_s_diam[[i]]$environmental
  )

md7 <- foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  lm(
    cwm_S_r_diam[[i]] ~ 1 + plot_size + samp_size,
    data = or_s_diam[[i]]$environmental
  )

# Select best model per iteration using AICc comparison
sel_diam <-
  foreach(i = 1:N) %dopar%
  {
    AICctab(
      md1[[i]],
      md2[[i]],
      md3[[i]],
      md4[[i]],
      md5[[i]],
      md6[[i]],
      md7[[i]],
      base = T,
      delta = T,
      mnames = models[1:7]
    ) %>%
      `class<-`("data.frame")  # Ensure output is a data.frame
  } %>%
  get_result() # Aggregate results from parallel loop

# View AICc model selection results
sel_diam

# Save the best model for rhizome diameter
model_diam <- md4

```

## Output

```{r}
## Elaborate a list of models
a <- list(model_diam,
  model_comp, #compact rhizome
  model_rcr, #short-creeping rhizomme
  model_lr, #long-creeping rhizomme
  model_mseg, #laminae multipinnate
  model_buds, # proliferous buds
  model_ltri, #trichome in laminae
  model_ind, #indusium and pseudo indusium presence
  model_dim, #laminae dimorphic
  model_spore #spore Chlorophyll
)

# Extract the coefficients from each model see "func/" folder for details of get_model function
model_results <- lapply(a, function (x) map_dfr(x, get_model))

head(model_results[[2]])

# Summarize the model coefficients
mod_df <- map_dfr(model_results, function (result){
  result %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      .cols = everything(),
      .fns = function(x) {
        paste0(round(mean(x, na.rm = T),6),"[±", round(sd(x, na.rm=T),6), "]")
      }
      )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(nsel= tapply(result$model, result$model, length), .before = 2)
})

view(mod_df)

#Save data
write.xlsx (x = mod_df, file = "outputs/Corrected/summ_models_tcor.xlsx", rowNames = T)


## Output resumed data
forw <- rbind(
  sel_diam, #rhizome diameter
  sel_rcomp, #compact rhizome
  sel_rcr, #short-creeping rhizomme
  sel_rlr, #long-creeping rhizomme
  sel_lmseg, #laminae multipinnate
  sel_buds, # proliferous buds
  sel_ltri, #trichome in laminae
  sel_ind, #indusium and pseudo indusium presence
  sel_lmorf, #laminae dimorphic
  sel_chl #spore Chlorophyll
) %>%
  mutate(models = rownames(.), .before = n_sel) %>%
  remove_rownames()

## Separete the models without predictors (bad_mods), from the model with at least one
## environmental predictor
rows <- grep("1", forw$models)
nice_mods_Scomp <- forw[-rows, ] # Models w/ env predictors
bad_mods_Scomp <- forw[rows, ] # Models without env. predictor (null models)

## output CWM List
cwm_list <- list()
cwm_list[[1]] <- cwm_S_r_diam
cwm_list[[2]] <- cwm_S_r_comp
cwm_list[[3]] <- cwm_S_r_cr
cwm_list[[4]] <- cwm_S_r_lr
cwm_list[[5]] <- cwm_S_buds
cwm_list[[6]] <- cwm_S_lam_mseg
cwm_list[[7]] <- cwm_S_ltri
cwm_list[[8]] <- cwm_S_chl
cwm_list[[9]] <- cwm_S_lmorf
cwm_list[[10]] <- cwm_S_ind
names(cwm_list) <- c(
  "diam",
  "r_comp",
  "r_cr",
  "r_lr",
  "buds",
  "l_mseg",
  "ltri",
  "chl",
  "lmorf",
  "ind"
)
```
